propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all findings regardless of type, but should accept bugfix-size-attestation blocks when the ticket carries a current valid plan-review attestation

the fix for a bugfix-size-attestation finding is to update the ticket plan and earn an attestation, not to amend the code, yet the label copy condition propagates the -1 vote even when the attestation is earned
eligibility for recheck-review acceptance must be determined solely from the bot's vote message and ticket store, never from the requesting comment, to maintain the security invariant

the acceptance condition must require the block to contain exactly one finding (by header count, not rendered list), and that finding must be exactly bugfix-size-attestation with a valid ticket attestation

attestations in FLAG_VERDICTS (stale-material, mismatch, invalid) or infra verdicts (unavailable, error) must still refuse recheck-review to prevent contributors from unlocking reviews with outdated or error-state evidence
